description: This file defines the SuiteEditorSettingsForDirectHTML class, which extends SuiteEditorSettings. It manages settings for a simple textarea editor, including properties for contents, textarea ID, and editor element ID, and has a constructor that sets default values and extends parent settings.

classes.name: SuiteEditorSettingsForDirectHTML
classes.description: A class extending SuiteEditorSettings to handle settings for a direct HTML textarea editor, with properties for editor contents and element IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with default settings for the editor and calls the parent constructor with optional settings.
